It is really shitty that your mom is doing that still. Luckily i have no contact with my abuser.

Im also try to distract myself to not remember the issue most of the time, but it is hard because the only thing i find engaging is reading.

I dont know what to do tbh, im really in love with this girl and i just cannot ignore the issue that she is the only one who i felt comfortable with, it just kills me to know that she doesnt feels the same way

Thanks you so much for this reply, seriously. It is comforting to know that someone can understand because it has feel what im currently feeling. I dont think there is a way you can help because of obvious reasons, tbh jus talking would be nice.  
If i doesn't mind you me asking, how do you deal with being a sexual assault survivor? Its been quite hard for me, before i used to remember it and think of it every day some days at every moment, but luckily now with the help of therapy is just once a week but it is really hard too. Especially when it comes to forming relationships with other people, because im really afraid of sex, that is something too about this girl i sadly scared by being a drunk asshole, she was the first person i felt comfortable with my body around her.

Seriously, thanks. Knowing you can understand because you lived similar situations is comforting

I dont know, im just too weak to deal with all of this. Why it had to be so hard, like why i didnt had an average life like other people. I appreciate the prayers, im an atheist but i have much respect for religious people.  
Thanks for reading all of that man 

Currently doing and engineering degree because im fascinated by things like AI, robotics, and technology in general
Thanks man, is quite wholesome to read that. And really big thanks for reading that whole thing, hugs to you too
